# Elizabeth

deceased

## Overview

- **Role:** missionary (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)</sub>

## Appearance

Elizabeth was known for her great beauty during her youth. Despite receiving numerous opportunities, she never married.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063)_

## Personality

Elizabeth is characterized as someone who lives primarily in the past. She is also described as a creature of mirth.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P48](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P4](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0004)_

## History

Elizabeth is a former story writer who previously left her home to serve as a foreign missionary. Fifteen years ago, she remodeled her house and installed a new fireplace. In her youth while visiting her government-official uncle in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown), she attended a grand ball where she was celebrated as the prettiest guest and danced with the Prince of Wales.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P25](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P61](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0061), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P63](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0063), [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P65](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0065), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P63](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0063), +23 more_

## Relationships

Elizabeth was taken in as the foster child of [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md) starting in Volume 3. Their household bond places Elizabeth under Aunt Jamesina's care and guidance, establishing a motherly dynamic between them as part of the Patty's Place family.
